description: Producer statements labeled with challenge tags from the 11-tag set, for tag-accuracy scoring (#36). Statements are synthetic, written in the style of producer intake messages. Every item starts as labeled_by 'draft' and needs a human reviewer to confirm or correct its tags, then set labeled_by to their handle.

items.text: Las lluvias llegaron tarde dos años seguidos y las flores del café se cayeron antes de cuajar.
The heat this year was worse than anyone remembers. The cocoa pods are drying out on the trees.
A cyclone flattened half of our banana plants in one night.
La quebrada de donde sacamos agua para el beneficio se está secando en verano.
The wastewater from washing the coffee is going straight into the river and our neighbours are complaining.
No llueve como antes y ya no alcanza el agua para regar.
La roya está atacando las plantas viejas y la tierra ya no produce como antes.
Our hillside plots are washing away every rainy season and we're losing topsoil.
Fertilizer has become so expensive that most members stopped using it, and yields are falling.
Buyers are paying us almost a quarter less per kilo than last year.
Los intermediarios bajaron el precio y no tenemos a quién más venderle.
Our main importer cancelled their contract and we have a warehouse full of cocoa.
Young people are leaving for the city and we can't find pickers at harvest time.
Muchos jornaleros se fueron a trabajar a otro país y la cosecha se queda en las plantas.
We are short fifteen workers in the factory and behind on every order.
El banco no nos quiere prestar para renovar los cafetales porque no tenemos títulos de la tierra.
We had to take a loan at a very high interest rate to pay for inputs before the harvest.
The cooperative can't pay members on delivery anymore because we have no working capital.
Los niños de la comunidad tienen que caminar dos horas para llegar a la escuela secundaria.
Most members have never had training in pruning or keeping farm records.
En la comunidad no hay puesto de salud, y cuando alguien se enferma hay que viajar a la ciudad.
Several workers got sick after spraying pesticides without protective equipment.
The road to the collection centre is impassable in the rainy season, so the cherries rot before we can sell them.
El secadero es muy pequeño y cuando llueve no podemos secar todo el café a tiempo.
We don't have reliable electricity at the processing plant, so the machines stop for hours.
People from outside are cutting down the forest next to our farms to plant pasture.
Ya casi no se ven abejas ni pájaros en los cafetales desde que los vecinos empezaron a fumigar.
There is rubbish and plastic everywhere around the village and nobody collects it.
Hay divisiones en la asociación y muchos socios ya no vienen a las asambleas.
Women in the cooperative say their ideas for the Premium are never taken into account.
The drought ruined the harvest, and now we can't repay the loan we took for inputs.
Con los precios tan bajos, los jóvenes prefieren irse a la ciudad que quedarse en la finca.
The well dried up and the women now walk an hour to fetch drinking water.
